add_library(cache_policy STATIC cache_control.cpp cache_policy.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cache_policy PUBLIC http core)
target_compile_features(cache_policy PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
set_target_properties(cache_policy PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(cache_policy PRIVATE /W4)
else()
    target_compile_options(cache_policy PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()
